hypothesis: The v206 listwise component scores each boat mainly from its own row and aggregate relative features. Explicitly exposing every candidate boat to the fixed-position features and candidate-minus-opponent differences of all six boats will improve structured trifecta probabilities by modeling local and outer-boat interactions.
research_basis: Boat-race SHAP study reports that neighboring boats and boats 5/6 affect outcomes beyond the target boat's own ability.
Groupwise scoring functions report gains when an item's score is computed jointly with other items.
Set Transformer formalizes interaction-aware set modeling; this experiment uses a lower-variance GBDT approximation suitable for 72k tabular races.

method.context_expansion: for each candidate and each absolute lane 1..6 append opponent raw feature and candidate-minus-opponent feature

interpretation: Passing creates a challenger only. It does not prove profitability and still requires frozen forward evidence.
